data.text: LORD, my heart is not proud, and my eyes are not haughty; I do not pursue great things or things too wonderful for me.
data.titulo: A Quiet Soul That Hopes in the LORD
data.subtitulo: A Song of Ascents. Of David.

data.text: Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within me.
Israel, hope in the LORD, from now on and forever.
